content_blocks.title: Inspectable Python example: Array Problem-Solving Techniques
content_blocks.code:
def lower_bound(values, target):
    lo, hi = 0, len(values)
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if values[mid] < target: lo = mid + 1
        else: hi = mid
    return lo
print(lower_bound([1, 3, 3, 7], 3))
